system.effect: Once per turn, when a Reaction you use increases one of your Defenses against an attack, choose one adjacent ally also targeted by that attack. That ally gains +1 to the same Defense against that attack. This property may contribute while another item is the Source.
system.special: No extra Reaction is created. You must actually increase your own Defense.
system.flavor: Sharing a small amount of protection against multi-target attacks.
